title: How Spivey and Lenny Kunstadt found her for London
summary: They called Willie Dixon from her house in Detroit to say they had found her, and she hesitated to go alone.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Now, who was playing the piano on the rest of those, on the rest of those tunes?
Where did you meet Little Brother?
Oh, you met him in London for the first time?
Yeah. Well, a little (unintelligible). She had been in London and they didn't make no go, the show was ___, you know.

And so they ___ Victoria no more, Victoria told them, say, "But I can send you somebody that can make your show go." So ___ Dixon was the one booking the blues singers, you know. So Lenny and (unintelligible) I was going to a rehearsal at choir that night. I had another ___ I was playing right around the corner from me and I say, "Well, Vicki," I say, "you don't want to go to church with me." I say, "You stay here until I

come back, because I'm going to rehearse the choir for an hour." I said, "Just stay here and I'll be back." It was right around the corner. It wasn't over here, it was on Marshall Street, it was over on the East side. So Lenny say, "Hot dog, what you know? I'm going to call Willie and tell Willie we have found Sippie." They had been looking for me and looking for me. So they called long distance. He said, "Sippie, can I use your telephone?" I said, "Yeah." So he used my -- on a Sunday night -- so he used my telephone and Willie wasn't there at first. So he say, "When Willie comes in, tell him to call me." When Willie come, Willie called Lenny at my number and Willie say -- and Lenny say, "Willie, I have found Sippie Wallace." And he say, " get her to go to London."

So Willie asked me would I go to London. So I say, "I don't know, I might," like that. But I wasn't much about going, because I asked Victoria if she going and she said, "London, I went." Because Vicki said she wasn't going, well, I wasn't so going by myself, you know, and had never been over there, you know.
